refreshPolicy: Required markers are conservative content checks, not a guarantee that an old announcement remains current. Preserve source and verification dates, expire or flag unavailable/conflicting evidence, and never auto-promote an elapsed announcement to released. New discoveries need their own title-specific source evidence.
